releaseName: Retries you can see, and an export preview
summary: A failed step now says whether DraftLoop retries it on its own and when, or that it cannot recover (#2495). Draft edits lock while a step retries (#2496), and Stop keeps a run stopped even when a step finishes after it (#2494). An approved run's export can be previewed in a dialog before you save it, for PDF and for Word from the same template's pages (#2505 to #2507). Groundwork for the invite-only public test, not yet reachable from the screen: a Beta plan with three economy runs (#2491), a deployment-wide monthly spend pool that refuses new runs past its ceiling when DRAFT_LOOP_SPEND_POOL_USD is set (#2500), and single-use invite codes under an account cap (#2504).
knownLimitations: Beta invites have no routes or screen yet, and the spend pool is off unless configured. Agents cannot approve or export: those stay in DraftLoop. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The screening shadow only logs. Live speech and the career interview still need DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude key on staging. The local-first desktop has no career interview.
